_comment: Blank rows slice 13 (v373). The next band of a regenerated census (scripts/vr-blank-pair-census.mjs). Every federal pair in the live record whose row prints nothing, ranked by distinct members with a row. After slice 12 the census holds 60 blank pairs. The ones above 100 members are all pairs earlier slices skipped, with their reasons unchanged. At 100 members sit exactly the six pairs slice 12's `next` named, and no others. They are four Senate confirmation votes and two Senate joint resolutions. The four confirmations take a line; the two resolution pairs are skipped. None stores a `did`. Each confirmation's rationale states the reach of the post ("Leadership of the U.S. Department of Justice"). So each line joins those words to the nominee's surname and post from the stored title, and opens "Confirmed": the stored status is enacted and the summary records the confirmation. `term` is the rationale's words the line carries and `termIn` names the field. None of the four acts carried a line before, so no line names a tally. `acts` carries every mapping on each act that takes a line. `skipped` lists the two band pairs left blank and why. No score, weight, mapping or key is read from or written to here.
